discovery: A weathered roadside shrine stands at the crossroads, its offering bowl half-filled with old coin and wilted flowers.

choices.label: Leave a Donation
choices.description: Drop 10 gold in the offering bowl
choices.outcome: You set ten gold in the bowl among the older offerings. For a moment, the road ahead feels a little less lonely.

choices.label: Pay Your Respects
choices.description: Take a quiet moment, no coin needed
choices.outcome: You bow your head at the shrine a moment before moving on, no coin spent but no less sincere for it.

choices.label: Walk On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking
choices.outcome: You walk past the shrine without stopping.
